aboutPage.title: About Tibyaan Academy
aboutPage.subtitle: A modern digital madrasah bringing authentic Islamic education to your home through technology and qualified teachers.
aboutPage.missionDesc: Tibyaan Academy was founded with a simple mission: to make quality Quran and Islamic education accessible to every Muslim, anywhere in the world. We combine the authenticity of traditional Islamic scholarship with the convenience of modern technology, offering live 1-on-1 classes with certified teachers, AI-powered learning tools, and a comprehensive curriculum from Nazra to Aalim course.
aboutPage.value1Desc: Our curriculum is designed by qualified Islamic scholars following traditional chains of learning.
aboutPage.value2Desc: Every student gets 1-on-1 live sessions with dedicated teachers who track individual progress.
aboutPage.value3Desc: AI Ustaz, progress tracking, and interactive activities make learning engaging and effective.
aboutPage.value4Desc: We nurture not just knowledge but also character, with Tarbiyah integrated into every lesson.

team.description: Professor Muhammad Tahir Hasni founded Tibyaan Academy with a vision to make authentic Islamic education accessible to Muslims across the globe. With decades of academic excellence, he has been a pioneer in bringing traditional Islamic learning to the online world. His mission is to bridge the gap between technology and religion, serving the Ummah through modern yet authentic means.

Mufti Muhammad Rafeeq Golarwi oversees the day-to-day academic operations of Tibyaan Academy. His core expertise lies in Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh) and Usool-ul-Fiqh, and he has played a key role in adapting the traditional Dars-e-Nizami curriculum for the modern digital age. Under his leadership, Tibyaan's Aalim Course and Fatwa department serve students from around the world.

Mufti Owais Ahmed leads Tibyaan Academy's flagship Aalim Course. He has successfully restructured the complete Dars-e-Nizami syllabus into an effective online format, enabling students to pursue the full journey of becoming a qualified Aalim from the comfort of their homes. His teaching style is clear, engaging, and deeply rooted in classical Islamic scholarship.

Sheikh Abdul Jabbar is a specialist in the Arabic language with deep expertise in Sarf, Nahw, Balaghat, and Classical Arabic Literature. He firmly believes that the direct path to understanding the Quran and Hadith is through mastering the Arabic language. His classes are structured in a way that even absolute beginners can quickly begin to understand the Quran with confidence.

Maulana Ali Haider has dedicated his entire life to the service of the Holy Quran. He specializes in teaching Hifz to students of all ages — from young children to adults. His proven teaching methodology instills consistency and strength in memorization. He has designed Tibyaan's online Hifz program in a way that allows every student to progress at their own pace without compromising quality.

Qari Muhammad Musheer heads the Nazrat and Tajweed department at Tibyaan Academy. His specialty lies in the precise articulation of Arabic letters (Makhaarij) and the rules of Tajweed. Thousands of students have learned to recite the Quran correctly under his guidance. His interactive and engaging teaching approach makes learning Quran enjoyable, particularly for children.

Qari Muhammad Ismail Hasni manages the complete administrative framework of Tibyaan Academy. From student enrollments and scheduling to fee management and teacher coordination — every operational matter falls under his supervision. His dedication and organizational skills ensure that the entire Academy runs smoothly and efficiently. He is always available and approachable for students' needs.

Ustaza Fatima Al-Zahra oversees all women's and children's programs at Tibyaan Academy. Her teaching approach is built on innovative methods and a nurturing, compassionate style that has helped thousands of women and children learn the Quran and Islamic sciences. She is the creative force behind Tibyaan's Kids Activities section. She believes that every Muslim home should be the first school of Deen.

aboutPage.ourStoryP1: Tibyaan Academy was born from a simple but powerful realization: millions of Muslims around the world desperately want to learn the Quran and Islamic sciences — but lack access to qualified teachers in their local communities.
aboutPage.ourStoryP2: Professor Muhammad Tahir Hasni, a dedicated educator with decades of experience, recognized this gap. He gathered a team of qualified Islamic scholars and educators and built Tibyaan Academy — a platform where authentic Islamic learning meets modern technology.
aboutPage.ourStoryP3: Today, Tibyaan Academy serves students from {countries} countries. Our students include children as young as 5 learning their first Arabic letters, young adults memorizing the Quran, professionals learning Arabic, and scholars pursuing the complete Aalim course — all from the comfort of their homes.

aboutPage.missionDescV2: To make authentic, high-quality Islamic education accessible to every Muslim on earth — regardless of location, age, or background.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.section1Content: We collect personal information you provide when creating an account, including your name, email address, and payment information. We also collect usage data such as lesson progress, quiz scores, and learning analytics to improve your experience.
privacyPage.section2Content: Your information is used to provide and improve our educational services, process payments, communicate with you about your account and classes, and personalize your learning experience. We never sell your personal data to third parties.
privacyPage.section3Content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Payment processing is handled by Stripe, a PCI-compliant payment processor.
privacyPage.section4Content: We take children's privacy seriously. For students under 13, we require parental consent before account creation. Parents can review, modify, or delete their child's information at any time by contacting us.
privacyPage.section5Content: If you have questions about this privacy policy or your personal data, please contact us at academytibyaan@gmail.com. We will respond to your inquiry within 30 days.

termsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
termsPage.section1Content: By accessing and using Tibyaan Academy's services, you agree to be bound by these terms and conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you may not use our services.
termsPage.section2Content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. Subscription plans are billed monthly or yearly as selected. You may cancel your subscription at any time, and access will continue until the end of the current billing period.
termsPage.section3Content: Live classes are scheduled between you and your assigned teacher. If you need to reschedule, please notify us at least 4 hours in advance. Missed classes without prior notice may not be rescheduled. We reserve the right to reassign teachers if needed.
termsPage.section4Content: You agree to use our platform respectfully and in accordance with Islamic values. Any form of harassment, inappropriate behavior, or misuse of the AI Ustaz system may result in account suspension or termination.
termsPage.section5Content: Tibyaan Academy provides educational services on an 'as-is' basis. While we strive for excellence, we do not guarantee specific learning outcomes. Our liability is limited to the amount paid for services in the preceding 12 months.
